items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1961-07-02
items.q: I never got to hear him. I overheard talk of him.

ctx.x: Do you remember when you were a boy, it was the old Billy Marrero, Lawrence's father. The old man played the bass, everybody said he was a wonderful musician. Did you get to hear him? Did you remember him?
I never got to hear him. I overheard talk of him.
